code_name: Pinal County Development Services Code, Title 2 Zoning (PCDSC Chapters 2.05-2.365)
edition: Zoneomics mirror, undated (shows ordinances through 2021). County also published a Jan 6, 2025 draft markup of the code that I could not read (403), so recent amendments may differ.
caveats: Text read from the Zoneomics mirror (https://www.zoneomics.com/code/pinal-county-unincorporated-AZ), not the official Municode or pinal.gov pages, which blocked automated access. Verify against Municode before relying.

Legacy districts (CR-*, TR, CB-*, CI-*, SR, SH, CAR, GR, MH, RV, MHP, RVP) are retained on existing parcels per 2.15.010 but unavailable for new rezonings; post-2012 districts (RU-*, R-*, MD, MR, C-*, I-*, MH-8, MHP-435, PM/RVP-435, MP-CMP, L-MPC) apply to new rezonings.

Data centers, solar farms and battery storage are not named in any business or industrial chapter I read (solar appears only as residential/park devices, chapter 2.210); treat as not addressed. Chapter 2.185 (outside storage), 2.151 (special use permits) and PAD overlays (2.175/2.176) were not read and can modify allowed uses.
I-1/I-2/I-3 correspond to CI-B/CI-1/CI-2 per the parallel chapter structure; the formal mapping was not verified in code text.
Districts GR-5, GR-10, SR-1, RU-5, RU-3.3, RU-2, RU-1.25, RU-C, R-43, R-35, R-20, AC-*, O-*, C-1, C-2 exist but were outside the requested list.

Airport/airstrip on 160+ acres (needs 75% neighbour consent); riding stable (20+ acres); hospital/clinic (4+ acres); private club (10+ acres); racetrack/stadium - each with site and neighbour-consent conditions inside 2.20.010

standards.setbacks: Front 50 ft; side 10 ft each; rear 50 ft
standards.other: Lot width: none. Detached accessory buildings: 100 ft from front lot line; 100 ft from side/rear lines if housing animals

districts.notes: Legacy district (existing before Feb 18, 2012); retained on existing parcels but not available for new rezonings. SR-1 (2.25) also exists, not documented here. The tail of the 2.20.010 list (after item N) was not fully read.

standards.setbacks: Front 20 ft; side none (7 ft residential); rear 25 ft
standards.other: Manufacturing, warehousing/distribution, truck terminals, outdoor storage, data centers, hazardous manufacturing, solar: not permitted/not addressed (the research-facility use explicitly excludes manufacturing and warehousing; accessory uses may not involve open storage).

Light manufacturing and warehousing: by right (indoors). Outdoor storage: effectively not allowed. Truck terminals, data centers, heavy/hazardous manufacturing, solar: not listed / not addressed.

Distribution plant, ice and cold storage, beverage bottling, wholesale business, storage building or warehouse (enclosed)
Auto/trailer assembly, truck repair, tire recapping
Draying/freighting/truck yard or terminal; contractor equipment yard; building-material yard; public utility yard (enclosed, or within 6-ft solid wall/hedge/fence)
Heavy truck storage, repair, staging and trucking point of operation
Airport on 160+ acres; gasoline/flammables bulk station (10,000-gal tank max, 100 ft from residential); LPG bulk station
Watchman/caretaker dwelling

standards.setbacks: Front 15 ft; side none; rear 10 ft; industrial buffer (10% of lot dimension up to 50 ft) where abutting residential or major/secondary thoroughfare
standards.other: Manufacturing, warehousing/distribution, truck terminals: by right (manufacturing wholly enclosed). Outdoor storage: yards allowed by right if enclosed by 6-ft solid wall/hedge/fence. Heavy or hazardous manufacturing (explosives, chemicals): not listed here; explosives manufacture appears only as an industrial-use-permit use in CI-2. Data centers and solar: not addressed.
